newsitem.title: UK: UK licences more Alvis exports to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: UK licences more Alvis exports to Indonesia.

text.p: The UK government has issued licences to Alvis Plc to export 50 more armoured vehicle and associated equipment to Indonesia, Trade and Industry Secretary Ian Lang said on Monday.

Lang said in a written parliamentary answer that the decision had been made "in the light of the established and international agreed criteria for military exports" following consultations between his department, the Foreign Office and the Defence Ministry.
In a separate answer, Lang said an export licence will also go to Procurement Services International Ltd to export a variety of police vehicles, including seven Tactica water cannon, to Indonesia.
Lang gave no figure for the value of the order.
